errors.text_span: bleibt relativ stabil bei etwa 8–9 Mrd. Euro pro Jahr
errors.evidence: The value for "Innere Sicherheit" (purple segment) is not stable at 8-9 billion Euros per year. It starts at approximately 4.5-5 billion in 2015 and increases to a peak of about 8.5 billion in 2022, but it is not stable in the 8-9 billion range for the whole period.
